title: Dinner with Emma
statementMd:
Jack decides to invite Emma out for a dinner. Jack is a modest student, he doesn't want to go to an expensive restaurant. Emma is a girl with high taste, she prefers elite places.

Munhattan consists of $*n*$ streets and $*m*$ avenues. There is exactly one restaurant on the intersection of each street and avenue. The streets are numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$ and the avenues are numbered with integers from $1$ to $*m*$. The cost of dinner in the restaurant at the intersection of the $*i*$-th street and the $*j*$-th avenue is $*c*_{*ij*}$.

Jack and Emma decide to choose the restaurant in the following way. Firstly Emma chooses the street to dinner and then Jack chooses the avenue. Emma and Jack makes their choice optimally: Emma wants to maximize the cost of the dinner, Jack wants to minimize it. Emma takes into account that Jack wants to minimize the cost of the dinner. Find the cost of the dinner for the couple in love.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*, *m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$) — the number of streets and avenues in Munhattan.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains $*m*$ integers $*c*_{*ij*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*ij*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the cost of the dinner in the restaurant on the intersection of the $*i*$-th street and the $*j*$-th avenue.

## Output

Print the only integer $*a*$ — the cost of the dinner for Jack and Emma.

## Note

In the first example if Emma chooses the first or the third streets Jack can choose an avenue with the cost of the dinner $1$. So she chooses the second street and Jack chooses any avenue. The cost of the dinner is $2$.

In the second example regardless of Emma's choice Jack can choose a restaurant with the cost of the dinner $1$.
statementZhMd:
杰克决定邀请艾玛共进晚餐。杰克是一名节俭的学生，他不想去昂贵的餐厅。艾玛是一位品味很高的女孩，她更喜欢高档场所。

Munhattan 由 $*n*$ 条街道和 $*m*$ 条大道组成。每条街道与每条大道的交叉口恰好有一家餐厅。街道编号为从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数，大道编号为从 $1$ 到 $*m*$ 的整数。在第 $*i*$ 条街道和第 $*j*$ 条大道交叉口的餐厅用餐的费用为 $*c*_{*ij*}$。

杰克和艾玛决定按以下方式选择餐厅。首先由艾玛选择用餐的街道，然后由杰克选择大道。艾玛和杰克都会采取最优策略：艾玛希望最大化用餐费用，而杰克希望最小化用餐费用。艾玛会考虑到杰克希望最小化用餐费用。请你求出这对情侣用餐的费用。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*, *m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$）——Munhattan 中街道和大道的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*c*_{*ij*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*ij*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $*i*$ 条街道和第 $*j*$ 条大道交叉口的餐厅用餐费用。

## 输出格式

输出唯一的整数 $*a*$——杰克和艾玛的用餐费用。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，如果艾玛选择第一条或第三条街道，杰克都可以选择一条使晚餐费用为 $1$ 的大道。因此她选择了第二条街道，而杰克可以选择任意一条大道。晚餐费用为 $2$。

在第二个样例中，无论艾玛选择哪条街道，杰克都可以选择一家用餐费用为 $1$ 的餐厅。
